name: diablo4-helper
description: Diablo 4 gameplay helper - forces every version-specific answer (builds, items, crafting, seasonal mechanics, D4Companion overlay) to be verified against live sources instead of a stale training cutoff. Carries researched references for itemization, the damage model, Horadric Cube recipes, Tuning Prisms and per-slot affix pools, a goal-driven crafting decision tree, and Barbarian/Whirlwind build data. Bundles a diablo.trade client that ranks listings by what the one available enchant would cost to fix them.
